baseline_kernel: current-source SGLang API-v1 DeepGEMM grouped masked BM128/stage-8

bottleneck.evidence: NCU: stock and BM16 candidate both sustain ~6.05 TB/s DRAM, so duration equals bytes moved divided by a bandwidth the candidate already matches. Reads are 406.91 MB against an irreducible 402.65 MB of E32xN6144xK2048 FP8 weights; writes are 4.60 MB against a 1.57 MB valid-row floor. Issue slots 5.49% busy, no spills, no local memory.

approaches.summary: Mirrored the FlashMLA pattern: KernelSpec.graph_only on the W2 hotspot entry, SGLANG_GLM52_W2_GRAPH_ONLY default on, and an eager decline before the ABI check and the hit/miss lock.
approaches.why: Removed the API-v1 Python provider tax that had made the selected eager leaf 0.80x. A GPU contract proved eager declines with zero provider launches, capture selects exactly one candidate node, and the captured graph is identical with graph-only on and off.

approaches.summary: Timed the existing per-call BM16 auto-stage candidate on graph leaf and graph containing-region lanes, 3 series x 50 AB/BA pairs per lane.
approaches.why: Graph leaf passes 3/3 series for all four hints at 1.084-1.096x, but the containing region lands on the threshold: worst estimators 1.0256-1.0281 against a required 1.03, and expected-M 9 fails all three series.

approaches.summary: Used one NCU capture to bound both planned PTX hypotheses before writing them.
approaches.why: The candidate is at 99.26% of its achievable DRAM floor with 0.50 us of total headroom, while the region gate needs about 2.5 us. Re-scoring each region lane at that unreachable floor still fails three of four hints.

lesson: Graph-only selection is the right fix when a Python provider tax hides a real device win, and it is worth keeping on its own merits. But it only exposes the kernel's true ceiling: once both arms sustain the same DRAM bandwidth, duration is bytes divided by bandwidth, and a tile or epilogue change can only win by moving fewer bytes. Compute the byte floor from the irreducible operand footprint before spending PTX identities on barrier or scheduling hypotheses.
transfers_to: small-M grouped masked GEMMs on SM100 where weights dominate DRAM traffic
serving callbacks where Python selector overhead is comparable to kernel time
caveats: The leaf gate passing while the containing region fails is the expected outcome when the target kernel is a third of the region: a 1.09x leaf becomes a 1.03x region.
The 0.50 us headroom assumes the achieved 6.043 TB/s is fixed; raising DRAM efficiency above the measured ~79% of peak was not attempted and has no concrete SASS defect to target.
Production remains default-off; no TP8/DP8/EP8 or checkpoint-backed acceptance was run.
